title: Wavemill workflow-state.json
description: Shape of .wavemill/workflow-state.json and its task records (HOK-3220). Derived from the WRITERS (save_task_state, state_mutate / task_state_mutate_existing sites that set .tasks[$id].*, mutateJsonState callers), never from readers. Every TaskRecord property must have a writer: shared/lib/workflow-state.writer-coverage.test.ts enforces it. additionalProperties stays true so an in-flight writer is never rejected; reader-only names (prNumber, headSha, prHeadSha, pullRequest) are deliberately absent.

session.description: tmux session that owns this state file.

started.description: When the state file was created.

jobs.description: Tracked background jobs, keyed by job id (legacy files store an array). Owned and validated by job-tracker.ts (mill-job.schema.json).

terminalTaskHistory.description: Tombstone history. Owned by terminal-inbox-cleanup.ts / the terminal reconciler.

terminalTaskTombstones.description: Compact terminal tombstones. Owned by terminal-inbox-cleanup.ts.

abortedCleanupAt.description: When a stale arm was aborted for cleanup. Monitor / reap-stale-challengers.ts.

abortedCleanupReason.description: Why a stale arm was aborted for cleanup. Monitor / reap-stale-challengers.ts.

agent.description: Agent CLI driving the current stage. save_task_state / reroute.

attempt.description: PR attempt identity. wavemill_persist_attempt_reconciliation / fresh-launch reconciliation.

capsuleDigest.description: Reconciliation capsule digest at queue handoff. set_task_queue_owned.

challenge.description: True when this task is an arm of a challenge pair. save_task_state.

challengeAborted.description: Challenge abort reason (operator abort marker, sibling-stalled, ...). challenge_abort_pair / task-abort.ts / challenge-pair-resolver.ts.

challengeAbortedNextAction.description: Operator next action for the abort. challenge_abort_pair.

challengeAbortedStage.description: Stage the arm was aborted in. challenge_abort_pair / challenge-pair-resolver.ts.

challengeArms.description: Pending/materialised challenger arms on the primary. challenge-arms.sh.

challengeCollapseReason.description: Why the pair collapsed (route-drift, multiple-varied-roles, ...). challenge-arms.sh / monitor.

challengeCompared.description: Comparison has run for this pair. mark_challenge_compared / void-challenge-record.ts.

challengeComparedSource.description: What marked the pair compared. mark_challenge_compared.

challengeModel.description: Model of the varied stage. save_task_state.

challengePairId.description: Pair id (the primary's task id). save_task_state.

challengeRepairAction.description: Operator repair command for an invalid challenge. mark_challenge_invalid.

challengeRole.description: Arm role: primary or challenger. save_task_state. Legacy rows may carry ''.

challengeStage.description: Stage varied by the challenge. save_task_state / challenge-arms.sh.

challengeVariedAgent.description: Expected varied-stage agent from the execution intent. challenge-arms.sh.

challengeVariedModel.description: Expected varied-stage model from the execution intent. challenge-arms.sh.

challengerLaunched.description: Primary has launched its challenger. Monitor fork trigger.

coderModel.description: Routed coding model. save_task_state / coder reroute.

comparisonBlockedReason.description: Why the comparison is blocked. Mill / monitor. Legacy rows written before the clear-by-del() convention carry null.

comparisonLaunchEvidence.description: Eval-evidence identity the comparison launched against (HOK-2963). Monitor.

comparisonPairingRepaired.description: Pairing metadata was repaired before comparison. Monitor.

comparisonRetryCount.description: Comparison retry attempts. Mill / monitor. Legacy rows written before the clear-by-del() convention carry null.

comparisonRetryMaxAttempts.description: Comparison retry ceiling. Mill / monitor. Legacy rows written before the clear-by-del() convention carry null.

comparisonRetryTargetIssue.description: Arm whose eval the comparison retry re-runs. Mill / monitor. Legacy rows written before the clear-by-del() convention carry null.

comparisonRunning.description: In-flight comparison descriptor. Mill / monitor. Legacy rows written before the clear-by-del() convention carry null.

comparisonState.description: Comparison lifecycle state (comparison_running, invalid_challenge, manual_comparison_needed, ...). Mill / monitor / challenge-recovery.ts.

comparisonTimedOutSides.description: Pair sides whose eval timed out. Mill / monitor. Legacy rows written before the clear-by-del() convention carry null.

dependsOnPr.description: Parent PR this task is stacked on {number, url, branch, parent_issue}. Dependency queue.

evalHardFailureRetryCount.description: Mirror of the challenge-eval-hard bounded-retry count. Monitor.

evalRunning.description: In-flight eval descriptor {issue, side, pr, phase, startedAt}. Mill / monitor. Legacy rows written before the clear-by-del() convention carry null.

launchFailure.description: Unlaunchable-route failure {reason, detail, recoveryAction, updated}. Monitor dispatch. Legacy rows written before the clear-by-del() convention carry null.

linearIssueId.description: Linear issue id this task writes to (task-identity.ts). save_task_state.

linearSyncedState.description: Linear state last rendered from this row's settled outcome and written successfully (HOK-3373, linear-state-renderer.ts). linear_state_converge.

manualComparisonArtifact.description: Path of a manual comparison artifact. Mill / monitor. Legacy rows written before the clear-by-del() convention carry null.

model.description: Model of the stage currently launched. Monitor stage launch.

paneReleased.description: Pane released by the terminal reconciler.

paneReleasedAt.description: When the pane was released. Terminal reconciler.

paneState.description: tmux pane disposition. set_task_*_owned / terminal reconciler.

phase.description: Workflow phase (planning, coding, review, ready, done, aborted, superseded, needs-user, ...). save_task_state / set_task_phase.

plannerModel.description: Routed planning model. save_task_state / route reseal.

pr.description: PR number. Shell writers (save_task_state, terminal reconciler) store a string; '' means no PR yet. Never spell this prNumber at the top level.

prReconciliation.description: PR reconciliation result. wavemill_persist_attempt_reconciliation / fresh-launch reconciliation.

provider.description: Provider of the stage currently launched. Monitor stage launch.

queueHandoffAt.description: Epoch seconds of the merge-queue handoff. set_task_queue_owned.

rehydration.description: Startup rehydration eligibility stamp. startup-terminal-preflight.sh / fresh-launch reconciliation.

reviewerModel.description: Routed review model. save_task_state / route reseal.

runId.description: Run identity minted at launch, never changed for the life of the row (HOK-3373, attempt-identity.ts). A relaunch of a settled issue mints a new one. save_task_state.

stageRole.description: Stage role of the current launch (planning, coding, review). Monitor stage launch.

status.description: Task status (active, needs-user, merged, aborted, superseded, error, ...). save_task_state and every stage gate.

statusClearedBy.description: Operator event that cleared status=error {command, seq, at}. Condition reconciler.

stopReason.description: Why the monitor stopped the task. Monitor.

supersededAt.description: When the arm was superseded. Startup preflight / challenge-pair-resolver.ts.

supersededReason.description: Why the arm was superseded. Startup preflight / challenge-pair-resolver.ts.

terminalRecordWritten.description: Terminal reconciler wrote the terminal record.

title.description: Linear issue title persisted at launch (HOK-3221). save_task_state.

traceId.description: Trace id resolved from features/<slug>/.trace-context.json. save_task_state.

windowId.description: tmux window id. save_task_state / window recreation.
